shapes.title: The data types shared between ActivityPods applications
shapes.intro: Each shape describes a type of resource stored in Pods. Reuse the shapes of other applications so that your users find their data everywhere, or <0>propose a new one</0>.
shapes.search: Search a shape by name, class (as:Event) or property…

shape.summary: A resource conforming to this shape is of type <0>{{class}}</0>.
shape.summaryNamed: A resource conforming to this shape is of type <0>{{class}}</0>. Its <1>{{property}}</1> property is used to name it in lists.
shape.summaryFile: This shape designates binary files (pictures, documents…) rather than RDF resources: it has no SHACL definition.
shape.noProperties: The SHACL definition constrains no property: any resource of this class is accepted.
shape.accessHelp: Add this shape to the <0>accessNeeds</0> of your <1>app.service.js</1>. Users will see “{{label}}” in the list of data the application asks access to.
shape.backendHelp: Create a service with <0>PodResourcesHandlerMixin</0>: it exposes <1>post</1>, <2>get</2>, <3>list</3>, <4>patch</4> and <5>delete</5> on each Pod's container, and can react to creations.
shape.usedByHelp: Access declared in the access needs of each application. Only applications available in {{language}} are listed.
shape.immutable: Shapes are immutable. To change the structure of this data, <0>propose a new shape</0> rather than modifying this one.

mostUsed.title: Most used shapes
mostUsed.intro: Based on the access needs declared by the {{count}} applications available in {{language}}. A shape already used by other applications is a good candidate for yours.
mostUsed.unused_one: {{count}} other shape is not used by any declared application yet.
mostUsed.unused_other: {{count}} other shapes are not used by any declared application yet.

applications.intro: The trusted applications referenced by ActivityPods, and the shapes they use.

applications.hidden_other: {{count}} other applications are available in other languages only.

propose.title: Propose a shape
propose.intro: Describe the data type your application needs. The site generates the two Turtle files and opens a draft pull request on the GitHub repository, which maintainers review before publication.
propose.disabled: Submitting proposals is not enabled on this server. You can still prepare the files below and open the pull request yourself.
propose.prefixHelp: Prefix of the ontology, also the folder of the files (as, vcard, foaf…).
propose.namespaceHelp: This prefix is not known to the repository yet: give the ontology IRI, ending with # or /.
propose.name: Name
propose.targetClassHelp: RDF class of the resources: prefixed (foaf:Project) or full IRI.
propose.describesInstanceHelp: Property naming a resource in lists, e.g. as:name. Optional.
propose.propertiesHelp: Optional. Without properties, any resource of the target class is accepted. Declare the ones your application reads or writes so that other applications know what to expect.

kinds.resource: A resource of a given class

propose.githubHandleHelp: You will be mentioned in the pull request for the discussion.
propose.motivationHelp: For which application, which need? Optional, added to the pull request.
propose.previewHelp: The files as they will be added to the repository.
propose.incomplete: Fill in the form to see the preview.
propose.successText: Thank you! Maintainers will review your proposal. Once merged, the shape will be available at {{uri}}.
propose.rateLimited: Too many proposals sent recently, please try again later.
